name: qkd_ectl_c
structural_change: qkd_ectl as THREE DIE LEAVES with their own clock roots (A 254.88 | B 254.88 | C 138.24 x 129.6 um) in place of the one 648-um tile (qkd_ectl_slot-q13r3: 14,806 sinks on one root, TritonCTS insertion 357..538 ps / spread 181, declared spine 616..654 ps, CTS hold repair stalled on 8,710 endpoints): the row FIFO is sliced by word bits (2 SRAMs in A, 2 in B), the e FIFO's SRAM level is 128 x 64 registers in C (no macro in the 138-um leaf), every leaf carries a copy of the control and a control-only copy of the FIFOs it does not hold, so no timing loop crosses a seam; every die input reaches each control copy three flops after its pin (start / exp_done / nb_cr +2 cycles, q beat +1, row response +1); S / E are strap pins
slot_change_request: qkd_ectl (32 slots ectl_*, 647.976 x 129.576) -> three abutting leaves W to E: qkd_ectl_a 254.88 x 129.6 (W: rq rs; S/N: row bits [511:0] of t0 / t1), qkd_ectl_b 254.88 x 129.6 (S/N: row bits [1023:512] + {lt, c} of t0 / t1), qkd_ectl_c 138.24 x 129.6 (E: si so; S/N: {q_data, q_beat, q_valid} of t0 / t1, e0..e3, s0..s3); each leaf its own ck (N, M5) and rst_n (S), 5-bit strap cfg = {E 3, S 2} per slot on S; seam buses A.E-B.W {rs_o 513, x 52} and B.E-C.W {x 52, rsv 1} at matching y; timing: start / exp_done / nb_cr 2 cycles later, q beat 1, row response 1 (layer step +2..3 cycles)

job.purpose: q13-kvleaves: qkd_ectl split into three die leaves -- leaf C (E face): E-face pin stages, the q beat path, the e FIFO (128 x 64 register level, no macro), scores / running max / tags, node-beat tags; own control copy. M5 leaf, own clock root, S / E strap pins.

benches.name: ectl3_layer_exact
benches.cmd: ECTL3=1 ESLOT=1 DQ=128 bash tools/qwen_kv_die/bench_gate.sh pos {RUN}/bench/layer_pos

benches.name: ectl3_layer_rmut
benches.cmd: RMUT=1 ECTL3=1 ESLOT=1 DQ=128 bash tools/qwen_kv_die/bench_gate.sh neg {RUN}/bench/layer_neg 0
